query: Prepare a one-page briefing for a meeting with Nvidia on 17 November 2026. Cover what changed in the last 30 days (news, launches, hires, deals), cite a source URL for every fact, and end with three open questions to ask.
briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: NVIDIA (Meeting: 17 November 2026)

**Window:** roughly 13 Oct to 12 Nov 2026. All facts below come from the search results provided. Where a source reports something the company has not confirmed, I say so.

## Leadership and governance (most material change)

- Jensen Huang has left all his positions, effective immediately, after 33 years as CEO. Longtime CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO and remains CFO until a successor is chosen. The board has started a search covering internal and external candidates. (https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition; https://meteoraweb.com/en/news/nvidia-jensen-huang-steps-down-as-ceo; https://mashable.com/tech/jensen-huang-affairs-nvidia-resignation-timeline)
- On 8 Nov, the board said it had confidence in Huang and his leadership team and would provide further updates as appropriate. (https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/statement-from-nvidia-board-of-directors)
- WSJ reported on 11 Nov that the board was preparing to oust Huang after two extramarital affairs, one with a suspected Chinese spy. This is a press report citing people familiar with the matter. (https://www.wsj.com/business/nvidia-is-preparing-to-oust-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-30f421ad)
- Wired, as summarized by Mezha, reported Nvidia hired a crisis PR firm at least a year before Huang acknowledged the affair. (https://mezha.net/eng/news/mezha-cbe54f11b05c0e59be5a05db_wired-_nvidia_hired)
- The newsroom lists a 10 Nov statement from the independent board members. The search results do not include its text or a direct URL. (https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition)

## Products and partnerships

- Nvidia, Rebellions and SK Telecom announced a collaboration on sovereign AI infrastructure using NVIDIA NVLink Fusion (8 Nov). (https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition, which lists it under "More News")
- An AWS–Nvidia announcement describes AWS deploying 2 million additional Blackwell Ultra, Rubin and Rubin Ultra GPUs across 2027–2028. (https://shattered.io/gpu-vs-tpu-vs-npu-ai-chip-camps-compared-2026)
- Vera Rubin NVL72 debuted in MLPerf Inference v6.1 results in September 2026. Rubin reportedly moved into production shipments in H2 2026. (https://shattered.io/gpu-vs-tpu-vs-npu-ai-chip-camps-compared-2026). Note: "reportedly" means this is not confirmed by a primary source.

## Deals and hires

- The results list no acquisitions dated within the last 30 days. The most recent listed deal is Hugging Face (1 Aug 2026, $12.90B), which falls outside the window. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/TXRhn2TKUD7t)
- No executive hires were found in the search results beyond the interim CEO appointment above.

## Upcoming

- Nvidia will report quarterly results around 4:20 p.m. ET on 17 Nov, with an earnings call at 5 p.m. ET. It is the first call since Huang's exit. (https://mashable.com/tech/jensen-huang-affairs-nvidia-resignation-timeline)
- The Q3 conference call was announced on 28 Oct. (https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition, which lists it under "More News")

## Open questions

1. **Leadership timeline:** What is the board's timeline for naming a permanent CEO, and will any strategic or capital decisions wait for that appointment?
2. **Post-results direction:** Following the 17 Nov results and the first call without Huang, what changes to guidance or priorities should we expect, and how is the Rubin ramp tracking against the AWS 2026–2028 GPU commitments?
3. **Governance and disclosure:** What further board updates are planned, and how is Nvidia handling the reported governance matters, including the reported PR-firm timing, to keep investor and partner confidence?
